name: slalom-airlines-journal
description: The Journal. Document-authored Edge Delivery Services blog for Slalom Airlines (fictional demo brand). Content lives in content/ as da.live storage HTML and renders locally through `npm run up` with no remote content source.

aemCliNotes.git-stub: aem up refuses to start unless the directory it serves contains .git with a resolvable HEAD and an origin remote. This directory sits inside the monorepo (whose .git is one level up) and Phase 4 forbids real remotes, so tools/ensure-git-stub.mjs writes a three file .git stub before every run. Git itself ignores it (no objects directory means it is not a valid repository), the monorepo keeps tracking eds-blog files normally, and nothing is ever fetched or pushed. See that script's header for the full story.
aemCliNotes.why-url-flag: The stub's origin URL is '.', which the CLI cannot parse, so it falls back to --url for its proxy base. The host is a never-provisioned placeholder; it is only touched by the CLI's own head.html and metadata.json probes plus any request that misses every local file, and the Journal is built so nothing misses. Browser-side traffic stays 100 percent localhost.
aemCliNotes.cli-version-verified: @adobe/aem-cli 16.21.15 on Node 25 (npm EBADENGINE warning at install is benign)
